findings.reason: the plan names an assertion its named fixture cannot produce and leaves the choice between a fabricated receipt and a restructured test to the implementing node, so the done-when should say the race is driven through the hook's delivery path so the receipt is one the hook wrote.
findings.text: §10's "the race test asserts the delivered receipt appears" cannot hold on the fixture it names: the test claims with `worker_inbox.claim()`, which is only `os.rename` (`reckon/hooks/worker_inbox.py:177-194`) and appends no receipt, so `delivered` is empty there even after the repair and a worker must either fabricate a receipt inside the test (making the assertion test its own fixture) or restructure the race through `deliver()`'s claim-and-receipt path, neither of which the section states

response_events.note: s10 now drives the race through the hook's delivery path so the receipt asserted is one the hook wrote
